amendment.reason: Replace the inherited torch.erfinv inverse-normal call by the distribution-equivalent Acklam rational approximation after the first preflight encountered a missing system libnvrtc-builtins.so.13.0.

purpose: Test the V84A1 attribution prospectively: retain the V70/V72 spatial copula, train a proper conditional marginal only on simulation-group/spatially embargoed fit objects, and explicitly model the rare lower and upper tails that V83 missed.

required_findings: V83 random-object holdout was not group independent in any domain
all three consumed validation selections failed at least one direct 1e-4 PIT tail
candidate/control rank-TV differences were below 0.005, attributing the primary rank failure to the conditional marginal rather than the V70/V72 spatial copula

single_model_change.changed: replace the V83 all-range RQS density by a normalized V83 RQS centre spliced at fixed standardized residual thresholds to learned conditional lower/central/upper masses and learned conditional exponential tail scales
single_model_change.unchanged: seven condition channels, V48 U-Net body, source-balanced batches, all 48 cube isometries, target standardization, fixed-step EMA selection, and the frozen V70/V72 spatial copula reserved for later production sampling

model.network: V48 three-level 3D U-Net with a 47-channel V83 RQS core plus four conditional tail channels

central_distribution.family: V83 unconstrained 16-bin monotone rational-quadratic spline, renormalized between the two splice thresholds

tail_distribution.conditional_mass: softmax of lower logit, fixed zero central logit, and upper logit
tail_distribution.physical_constraint: upper scale at most 1.5 gives 1 - 2 ln(10) target_std beta_max = 0.3177070386410583 > 0, so the residual contribution to physical density squared is finite

threshold_provenance.rule: round the median domain q005 and q995 to two decimals before any training

model.spatial_factorization: V84B learns no spatial latent transform; a later production candidate may reuse V70/V72 only after this group-held-out marginal gate passes

partition.source: immutable V35 train files only; validation files are outside the V84B contract

algorithm.TNG100: seed 840184 periodic-uniform anchor; 44 nearest observer centers are holdout; discard every other center within 10 cMpc/h of any holdout center as embargo
algorithm.SIMBA: seed 840185 permutation of realization IDs; hold out two complete realizations
algorithm.Swift: seed 840186 permutation of realization IDs; hold out three complete realizations

partition.holdout_use: one fixed post-training mechanism gate only; never early stopping, checkpoint selection, threshold selection, or hyperparameter selection

training.batch: one uniformly sampled group-fit object from each domain
training.augmentation: one independently uniform choice from all 48 signed cube isometries per source and step

checks: all frozen implementation and train-input hashes
at least 100000 fit voxels in each tail and domain
finite upper physical second moment for every allowed upper scale
finite proper NLL and nonzero gradients in both central and tail heads
peak allocated GPU memory below 28 GiB
no group-holdout voxel, validation, consumed development, Astrid, or historical EAGLE payload access

group_holdout_gate.access: exactly once after the fixed checkpoint and training report are sealed
group_holdout_gate.pass_action: record result and prospectively design an all-train production refit without changing model or hyperparameters
group_holdout_gate.failure_action: stop V84B without opening any validation or consumed-development payload

authorization.approved_scope: prospective contract, hard preflight, one fixed group-fit training, and exactly one group-held-out mechanism gate
